en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a scenic coastal view framed by two large trees in the foreground. Below the trees, several people stand and sit on a grassy slope overlooking a bright blue bay. In the water are a small islet with a white building and another rocky islet further back. Mountains rise in the distance. The lower margin contains the printed caption in French and some handwritten text, along with the URL watermark 'www.elia.org.gr'.
